Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

bluelineR (development version)

  • IIHF tournaments, from the IIHF’s live-data feed (realtime.iihf.com): iihf_schedule() lists a tournament’s games (the World Championship, World Juniors, women’s and under-18 Worlds and the divisions), iihf_olympic_games() every game of the 2026 Olympics, iihf_game() one game, iihf_period_stats() each team’s shots, saves, penalty minutes, power play and faceoffs by period, iihf_events() goals with assists and strength, penalties and goalie changes, and iihf_shots() every shot with its result (goal, saved, blocked, missed) and place on the ice, from the 2019 tournaments on. plot_shots() draws them, and knows the IIHF nations’ colors.

  • DraftKings odds and props from ESPN: espn_odds() (moneyline, puck line and total, opening and current, with no-vig chances), espn_props() (every player prop, over and under paired, with each player’s NHL id), espn_player_splits() and devig().

  • nhl_player_bio(): the v2 player bio, with the draft and every NHL award and its season.

  • nhl_team_comparison(), nhl_broadcasts() (the viewing guide), nhl_quick_stats() (the static standings, power-play and leader files at live.nhle.com/psr), nhl_news() and nhl_videos() (NHL.com’s content API).

  • nhl_playoff_series() and nhl_playoff_games(): a franchise’s playoff record against each opponent, and every playoff game of any season, from records.nhl.com.

  • nhl_edge_leaders() has all thirteen EDGE top-10 boards: skater shot location, team shot speed, distance, zone time and shot location, and the goalie boards (5 on 5, by area, games above .900).

  • Records helpers: nhl_franchise_records() (each franchise’s record in Game 7s, overtime, season openers, outdoor games, games outside North America and at other neutral sites), nhl_draft_lottery() (every draw since 1995: the pick, the clubs, the player) and nhl_draft_lottery_odds() (each club’s chance, 1995 to 2021), nhl_milestones() (players closing in on a milestone, and how far they have to go), and nhl_records_catalog(), a guide to the 78 records tables with the helper for each. nhl_records() takes include to join related fields such as names and team codes.

  • nhl_jersey_url() (club jersey textures), and broadcaster logos in nhl_broadcasts().

  • nhl_stat_eras(): what the NHL kept and since when, as eras (goals and assists from 1917-18, shots and plus/minus from 1959-60, ice time from 1997-98, hits from 2005-06, located play-by-play from 2009-10, shift charts from 2010-11, tracking from 2021-22) and as each stats column’s first season, measured against the live API. nhl_stats() says when it is sorting by a column the NHL did not keep for the seasons asked for, and nhl_pbp() and nhl_shifts() say what an old game has.

  • nhl_era_adjust(): era-adjusted stats. Each season rescaled to one scoring environment (by default the last ten completed seasons, over an 82-game schedule and today’s roster sizes): adjusted goals, assists and points for skaters, adjusted GAA and save % against the league’s for goalies. nhl_league_env() is the table it reads, every completed season since 1917-18, shipped with the package.

  • nhl_player_game_log() and nhl_boxscore() read seasons before 1997-98, which have no ice time (they used to fail on them), and plot_shots() says why when a game has no shot locations.

  • plot_shots() draws each club at its own end, the away club at the left net and the home club at the right; sides = "right" keeps the old view with every shot at one net.

  • nhl_international(), nhl_international_careers(), nhl_international_games(), nhl_international_winners() and nhl_olympic_podiums(): every Canada Cup, World Cup of Hockey, Olympics and 4 Nations Face-Off with NHL players, from records.nhl.com.

  • animate_goal() puts GOAL in the middle of the rink and labels overtime goals OT.

  • Goal plots and videos use national colors for the 4 Nations Face-Off, whose goals are tracked.

  • animate_goal(logos = TRUE) puts the clubs’ logos in the title and the home club’s at centre ice, or any SVG or PNG with centre_logo; nhl_goal_replay() has the logos’ addresses. “GOAL” now flashes on a scoreboard panel.

  • animate_goal() writes a goal’s tracking replay as an MP4: every player and the puck on the rink, sweater numbers in club colors, the puck’s trail, the scorer and his assists named, his skating speed, and the last three seconds again at half speed.

  • nhl_tracking_summary(), nhl_tracking_player_stats() and nhl_tracking_entities() read the game tracking files at live.nhle.com/ppt: each player’s speed, distance, zone time, zone starts and puck possession time, each club’s possession by zone and strength, ice time by strength and every shift.

bluelineR 0.1.0

  • First release: scores, schedules, standings, play-by-play, box scores and shift charts; players, rosters, prospects, club stats, stat leaders and the draft; the stats and records APIs; NHL EDGE (skater, goalie and team reports, leaderboards, last night’s standouts); and goal tracking frames with goal_frame(), classify_goal(), goal_context(), skater_speed() and rink plots.
